apiVersion: bower.security/v1
kind: TelemetryPolicy
metadata:
  id: BWR-POL-AUTH-SUPPRESSED
  name: Authentication failures, suppressed
  version: 1.0.0
  owner: Security Operations
match:
  eventCategories:
    - authentication
  eventTypes:
    - authentication_failure
requirements:
  requiredFields:
    - timeGenerated
    - eventType
  atLeastOne:
    - actor.username
decision:
  action: accept
  minimumValueScore: 50
  neverSample: false
suppression:
  keyFields:
    - actor.username
    - source.ipAddress
  windowSeconds: 60
  allowPerWindow: 2

apiVersion: bower.security/v1
kind: TelemetryPolicy
metadata:
  id: BWR-POL-SUPPRESSION-SUMMARY
  name: Suppression summaries
  version: 1.0.0
  owner: Security Operations

  eventTypes:
    - telemetry_aggregation_summary
requirements:
  requiredFields:
    - timeGenerated
    - eventType
    - application.name
    - target.id
decision:
  action: accept
  minimumValueScore: 50
  neverSample: true
